title: Hall photon theory, copyrighted 1997 and inspired by faster-than-light craft

tellings.quote: I first copyrighted whole photon theory in 1997

plain: A man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years among tall white beings near Indian Springs, Nevada, says he worked out a physics idea he calls photon theory from watching their craft travel faster than light, and first copyrighted it in 1997. Hall tells this about his own work, citing a man named Emil Marzac, and points to his books Beyond Relativity and Mirage Galaxies and Edges in Space. If he is right, alien craft he says he saw would have shown a way past Einstein's speed limit.
